review:
Gates of Valhalla is an earlier Pragmatic Play release that pairs a Norse theme with tumbling wins and a roaming wild. Rather than relying on multiplier orbs, it places a wild that moves to a new random position after every tumble. When that wild is part of a win it applies a multiplier of up to 5x to the combination, so a long chain of tumbles gives it several chances to boost wins from one spin.

Three free spins symbols open the bonus, which awards up to 10 free spins with a multiplier that increases and applies to the total of all tumbles in a spin. It is a more modest design than the studio's later mythology hits, and the advertised top win of 5,000x reflects that. Worth a look in demo if you want a Viking-themed tumble slot with a simpler feature set than Gates of Olympus.
